standard-dialogue.npc: I'm Sherlock, master of clues and challenges.
If you find a scroll that requires my attention, bring it to me and I shall handle it.

treasure-trails-skill-challenge.npc: Ah, just what I was looking for. I have a challenge for you. If you complete it, I'll give you something.

treasure-trails-skill-challenge.text: You have completed your elite/master level challenge!

using-non-requested-items-on-sherlock.npc: That's nice, but.... I don't really need one of those.
